source_units.text: Offer a literary interpretation of an invented dream sequence.
Write for readers discussing an invented surreal story.
These invented details are required: The dream shows a staircase of cups reaching toward the locked sky.
Interpret it as an unfinished conversation, while allowing a second reading about fragile ambition.
Include each of these exact strings: "a staircase of cups", "the locked sky", "an unfinished conversation".
The total word count must fall from 55 to 85, inclusive.
